findings.reason: the node's declared write paths cannot carry the mechanism §4 rests on, so it either blocks on its fence or leaves the launcher selection unimplemented.
findings.text: §4 says a variant that differs by server "is keyed in `gpu_variants` by server name as well as card count" and that this runs through `ModelProfile.for_gpus`, "which `_scale_profile` already applies on the serve and restart paths"; but `for_gpus(self, gpus: int)` (profile.py:432) looks up `self.gpu_variants` — keyed `int` — with the card count alone, and `_scale_profile` is called at cli.py:606 with only `gpus`, before the server is resolved at cli.py:639, so it cannot reach a server-keyed entry; neither the refusal in the negative control (`--server b300 --gpus 2`, which today falls through to proportional scaling at cli.py:254) nor the server-keyed lookup can live anywhere but `cli.py` — where `_scale_profile`'s signature and its five call sites (cli.py:606, 797, 2344, 2891, 3040) must change — yet cli.py is absent from §4's write paths, so a node would hit its write fence

findings.reason: the node cannot tell a broken implementation from an undeclared server, and the fix — naming the declaration (a fixture site, or an explicit placeholder declaration) — belongs in the plan's done-when.
findings.text: §4's done-when requires `imas-ambix agent serve deepseek-v4-1-flash --server b300 --gpus 4|8 --dry-run` to print a complete script, but `serve` resolves the server through `SiteConfig.from_env().resolve_server` and refuses an undeclared name (profile.py:706 raises "undeclared server …; this site declares: …", wrapped at cli.py:642), while §4 itself defers the b300 host, partition, account and reservation to the open question `b300-arrival-facts` and names no site-config path among its write paths, so the command as written fails until the hardware is declared

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `ModelProfile.for_gpus` (imas_ambix/agent/profile.py:432), `gpu_variants` (:430), `_scale_profile` (imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:234), `SiteConfig.servers` (profile.py:569), serving-across-servers §3 (servers declared) and §7 (one model on more than one engine), and the capacity study §6 "~30 tok/s per request" column all resolve to the content claimed.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §4's first done-when bullet runs `agent serve ... --server b300 --dry-run`, which cannot print a script while no b300 server is declared, and the declaration is deferred to the open question `b300-arrival-facts`.
